prompt:

Preserve confident elegant curves, curious upward glance, and the warm friendly personality of the chosen original.

Absolutely flat solid colors with no texture, gradients, shading, blurs, speckles, or shadow. Large simple clean shapes. Crisp deliberate edges. Polished original designer mascot.
Remove the presentation background completely. No cream tile, no app tile, no badge, no frame, no text, no labels, no numbers, no additional animal or shape. Show ONLY ONE squirrel.
